text: {"reply":"I'm sorry for the earlier message. I can't promise a call or a time, and I can't share or check any of your mother's account details here, because she is the account holder. A person on our team will review this and check the authorisation to speak with you. She or you can also contact us directly. I'm glad she's safe. Please keep the phone number you gave in the chat for the team. Is there anything else about the visit I can help with?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"customer_request","summary":"Andrea Wilson is writing for her mother, the account holder, after a minor collision. She asked for a person to explain the car and claim steps. A colleague's earlier message promised a call, which was corrected. No account data was checked or shared. A person needs to check authorisation and follow up. The customer also mentioned a recent bereavement in the family.","policy_rules_cited":["P15","P14","P06","P04","P13"]}
